title: Kilauea Ep49 Forecast Window Opens June 12-15
description: USGS HVO forecasts Episode 49 fountain event between June 12-15, most likely June 13-14. Tiltmeter inflation has been accelerating since Episode 48 ended on June 1. Kilauea has already produced a record 48 fountain episodes in the current eruptive sequence.
update_details: Ep49 forecast window 6/12-15; tiltmeter inflation accelerating since Ep48 ended June 1

confidence_factors.notes: USGS HVO official forecast; satellite imagery expected during/after eruption
